description: Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Credit Agreement, Syndicated Term Sheet, or Initial Loan Estimate establishing committed facility limits, base origination fees, and underwritten Net Operating Income (NOI) covenants. Where to read: Identified by "Credit Agreement", "Senior Term Loan Facility Term Sheet", or "Loan Estimate" headers and the Summary of Principal Terms schedule on Pages 1-3. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with a final TRID Closing Disclosure or signed Schedule B Fee Addendum (`trid-closing-disclosure`), which carries higher settlement authority (`priority 40`), or with a standalone property valuation report (`mai-appraisal`).

issuer.description: Administrative agent, lead arranger, syndicated lender group, or issuing bank.

loan_amount.description: Committed principal loan facility amount in the agreement's currency. Where to read: Summary of Terms / Article II Commitments ('Senior Term Loan Facility' or 'Loan Amount'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract uncommitted accordion expansion options or appraised collateral value.

origination_fee.description: Base upfront origination or arrangement fee stated in the initial credit agreement or term sheet. Where to read: Fee Letter summary or Section A Origination Charges row. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract late payment penalties, exit fees, or annual administrative agent fees.

net_operating_income.description: Underwritten annual Net Operating Income (NOI) used for debt-service coverage covenants. Where to read: Financial Covenants schedule or Underwriting Summary table. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract Gross Potential Rent (GPR) or Effective Gross Income (EGI) before operating expenses.

facility_limit.description: Maximum aggregate credit facility commitment limit when distinct from initial draw. Where to read: Definitions / Schedule 2.01 Commitments table. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract swingline sublimits or letter-of-credit sublimits.

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g. USD). Where to read: Definitions section ('Dollars' or 'Alternative Currency') or header monetary notation. Distinguish from: Normalize currency symbols ('$') to ISO 4217 code ('USD').

effective_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the credit agreement or term sheet becomes effective. Where to read: Preamble or Summary of Terms header block. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the Maturity Date or Stated Termination Date.
